title: Site visit
text: Jason visits your home, measures up, and talks through what's possible for your space and budget.

title: Detailed quotation
text: You receive a comprehensive, itemised quotation, a fixed price, not an estimate.

title: The build
text: Director-managed from day one, to an agreed schedule, with one person answerable throughout.

title: Handover
text: Finished on time, snagged, and signed off with you, the price we quoted is the price you pay.
